lines.zh: 我挂在叶背下，被风吹得晃。
lines.en: I hang under a leaf, rocking in the breeze.

lines.zh: 我没有脚可以走，只能挂着。
lines.en: I have no feet to walk; I can only hang.
When the branch moves, I swing with it.

lines.zh: 我被固定在这片叶子上。
lines.en: I am fixed to this leaf.

lines.zh: 风从这边来，我就往那边偏。
lines.en: The wind comes from one side and I lean the other.
My casing is hardening.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我一下，我没动。
lines.en: Something touched me and I did not move.
I cannot even shift myself.
The leaf bends down under me.

lines.zh: 雨打在我身上，顺着流下去。
lines.en: Rain strikes me and runs off.

lines.zh: 我在等里面那部分长好。
lines.en: I am waiting for the inside of me to finish.
I grow a little heavier each day.

lines.zh: 我随着枝条慢慢转了个方向。
lines.en: The branch slowly turns me.
I did not choose where to be.
I hold to the leaf vein, very steady.
I sway twice and settle.
I hang there without moving.
My casing has a touch of green.
Something inside me shifts now and then.

lines.zh: 我一整天都是这个样子。
lines.en: I am like this all day.
I cannot see outside.
I can feel the light.
My shape is set.
The wind stops, and I stop swaying.
Fine lines run over me.
I know I am close to changing.

lines.zh: 我靠壳里剩下的那点力气。
lines.en: I live on what little is left inside this shell.
I hear something moving below.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，可你离得很近。
lines.en: I cannot see you, but you are very close.
You have reached a hand toward me.
Do not let your hand touch this shell.

lines.zh: 我被固定在这儿，走不了。
lines.en: I am fixed here and cannot leave.

lines.zh: 你靠近的时候，影子盖住我了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me as you approach.
I need a little more time.
Your fingers are right beside me.

lines.zh: 我里面在动，你听得见吗。
lines.en: Something inside me moves; can you hear it?

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是动不了。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you; I simply cannot move.

lines.zh: 你现在拿走我，就什么都看不到了。
lines.en: Take me now and you will see nothing.

lines.zh: 我的壳上多了一条细白痕。
lines.en: A thin white line has opened on my casing.
I swayed hard enough to nearly fall.
Something inside withdrew.
I grip the leaf tighter.
I might fall.
That truly hurt.
I cannot make a single sound.
The leaf has been pulled crooked.
I am still hanging under this leaf.
I want this to be over.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴上什么也没有。
lines.en: There is nothing at all on my mouth.
This body has no mouth.

lines.zh: 你举着叶子，不是给我的。
lines.en: You hold a leaf; it is not for me.
All I want is time.

lines.zh: 那东西对我来说没有意义。
lines.en: That means nothing to me.
I cannot even reach it.
Please put it back.
Wait until I am finished.
I need nothing at all right now.
You keep this one.
You touch me and I rock for a long while.

lines.zh: 这一下让我转了个角度。
lines.en: That turned me to a new angle.

lines.zh: 我的外壳硬了，没那么容易破。
lines.en: My casing has hardened; it does not break easily.
I cling to the leaf and do not fall.

lines.zh: 这一下让我里面的东西动了。
lines.en: That set something moving inside me.
I slowly swing straight again.
Do not push this leaf.
I nearly got knocked off.
My hold is still sound.
Step back so I can steady.
I cannot, in this shape.
Ask me after I have come out.
I do not even have wings yet.

lines.zh: 我这副壳装不下那种事。
lines.en: That has no room in a shell like mine.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，什么也做不了。
lines.en: I am inside a shell; there is nothing I can do.
This is not my stage.
I am still changing inside.

lines.zh: 等羽化了，会有别的蝴蝶。
lines.en: After I emerge, there will be other butterflies.
I hang here and cannot answer.
In this period I only grow.
I cannot pick anything up.

lines.zh: 有东西落在我旁边的叶上。
lines.en: Something landed on the leaf beside me.
It bends the leaf further.
I cannot even touch it.
That will fall, surely.
It presses me back into myself.
It weighs the leaf down; I can only fret.
It slid off along the leaf.
I cannot even touch it.
I hope it does not come again.

lines.zh: 我感觉到有什么靠近了。
lines.en: I sense something approaching.
All I can do is wait.
My casing has tightened slightly.

lines.zh: 如果被吃掉，也只能这样。
lines.en: If I am eaten, so be it.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅膀挣了一下。
lines.en: The wings inside struggle once.
The time left is short.
I heard footsteps.
This leaf is trembling.
I draw myself tight.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，请你再等一等。
lines.en: I am still in the shell. Please wait a while.

lines.zh: 我一直被这片叶子固定着。
lines.en: This leaf holds me in place.
I sway because of the wind.
I cannot see where you are.
I can feel the shadow.
I will not run, and cannot.
It is getting crowded inside.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离不会变。
lines.en: The distance between us will not change.
I simply hang here.
You still have not gone.
When the time comes, it will be too late.
I have not the slightest means.
I have no mouth, no claws.
I can only endure it.

lines.zh: 我的壳面裂开一道小口。
lines.en: A small split opens in my casing.
The part inside is still moving.
The blow leaves me hanging askew.

lines.zh: 重量压过来，我只能吊着。
lines.en: The weight bears down; all I can do is hang.
This body only waits.
My silk still holds.
Please move away from me.

lines.zh: 叶背上多了一小团东西。
lines.en: A small thing appears on the underside of a leaf.
I have only just formed.
I hang beside the leaf vein.
The light here is not strong.
I took this leaf.

lines.zh: 外面还在下雨，我听见了。
lines.en: It is still raining outside; I hear it.
My casing is still soft.
So I hang.
A gust turns the leaf over.

lines.zh: 我第一次感觉到外面的空气。
lines.en: I feel the outside air for the first time.
The heat bakes me dry.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下来，摔在草里。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf and land in the grass.

lines.zh: 水浸透了我的壳，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water soaks through my casing and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把叶子连同我一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast rips the leaf away with me on it.
Something punched through the leaf.

lines.zh: 一股力让我的壳变硬又变脆。
lines.en: Some force makes my casing hard and brittle.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我也在耗着。
lines.en: I have no mouth, yet I am still running down.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我整个都麻了。
lines.en: The thunder rattles me numb all over.

lines.zh: 丝断了，我朝下面一直落。
lines.en: The silk snapped; I keep falling.
